description: This Dart source file defines multiple Flutter widget classes related to the UI of a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including background decoration, mode toggle, player info chips, and scoreboard components.

classes.name: OceanBackground
classes.description: A widget providing an ocean gradient background for the entire screen.

classes.name: ModeToggle
classes.description: A toggle widget to switch between game modes: 'Two Players' and 'Vs Computer'.

classes.name: _SegmentButton
classes.description: A private widget representing a selectable segment button within ModeToggle.

classes.name: PlayerInfoChip
classes.description: A small UI component to display information about a player, such as 'X' or 'O', with optional highlighting.

classes.name: ScoreBar
classes.description: A widget showing the current scores for X and O players, with controls to reset the game or scores.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Override method to build the OceanBackground, ModeToggle, PlayerInfoChip, or ScoreBar widgets.

methods.name: onTap
methods.description: Callback invoked when a segment button or reset button is pressed.

methods.name: _scorePill
methods.description: Helper method in ScoreBar to generate score display widgets.
